title: 11 Real Stats From Hona Customers That Are So Good You Might Double Take
summary: Yes, Hona really is that effective for client communication and managing case updates. Hear from the firms using it every day to talk with clients.
body_markdown:
Is Hona really that effective for client communication and managing case updates? Don't ask me. Ask the law firms using it every day.


All of these stats come self-reported, straight from attorneys and their teams that use Hona on an everyday basis. Their practice areas include personal injury law, disability law, and family law.


## Increasing Case Volume


- 67% overall increase in case load for the firm — without adding attorney headcount — within 10 months of implementing Hona
- 149% increase in active cases without hiring 1-3 additional full-time staff, like was originally projected with that level of growth
- A team of three case managers each increased their active caseload by ~15%


## Taking Back Hours and Hours of Time


- Pre-hearing calls went from 60 minutes to 15 minutes, saving staff over 1,500 hours total (equal to 37.5 workweeks)
- Manual intake calls took <10 minutes, previously taking 30 minutes on average
- 100 hours per week saved by reducing inbound calls asking for case updates
- 71% fewer phone requests fielded for case updates after using Hona for 90 days


## Happier and More Engaged Clients


- Achieved a near-zero dissatisfaction rate, jokingly referring to rare complaints as coming from “the 0.7%ers.”
- Portal adoption rates jumped from 86% to 93% for hundreds of clients with specific praise for the communication process
- A single client checked the Hona portal 200+ times to learn about their case and the legal process instead of calling the firm
- 57% increase in 5-star Google Reviews 30 days after implementing Hona


With Hona,[law firms eliminate manual communication tasks](https://www.hona.com/engage) , provide consistent case updates, and educate clients about the legal process. All in a portal that clients access anytime.
